cards.reconciliation.processing.title: This action is processing
cards.reconciliation.processing.body: The action has been confirmed and is processing. Its status will update when processing completes. Do not submit it again.
cards.reconciliation.processing.help: Refresh later or contact support to check progress.
cards.reconciliation.recoverable.title: This action can be recovered
cards.reconciliation.recoverable.body: The action may have been submitted without a recorded outcome. The server has classified recovery as safe. Recover execution to verify and record the outcome.
cards.reconciliation.recoverable.help: Recovery does not charge twice. The server records the result only after checking existing execution records.
cards.reconciliation.reconciliation.titl: This action needs a manual review
cards.reconciliation.reconciliation.body: The action may have executed without a recorded outcome. Its outcome cannot be determined automatically, so the action will not retry automatically.
cards.reconciliation.reconciliation.help: Check account transactions and audit records. Do not execute again while the outcome remains unknown.
chat.error.request: The request failed. Check the connection and try again later.
chat.error.requestStatus: The request failed (HTTP {status}). Check the connection and try again later.
chat.error.incompleteStream: The response ended before completion. An attempt was made to read saved replies. Refresh the conversation and operation history before submitting again.
chat.error.interruptedStream: The connection was interrupted. An attempt was made to read saved replies. Refresh the conversation and operation history before submitting again.
chat.error.requestIdUnavailable: This browser cannot create a request ID. Use a current browser and try again.
chat.error.unknownOutcome: The request could not be completed. Reload the conversation to check its status.
chat.error.noPlan: There is no task plan to control. Create a task in the assistant first.
chat.error.newBankingRequest: No banking operation was started in this turn. You can continue the conversation.
chat.error.planNotSubmitted: The task was not submitted. Check the banking details and describe the request again.
chat.error.operationNotStarted: The operation was not started. Check the request and its original operation card.
chat.error.toolFailed: The operation is incomplete. Check the original operation card and account records.
chat.error.invalidDetails: The banking details did not pass validation. Check the object, amount and time.
chat.error.objectUnavailable: The requested banking object was not found. Refresh the records and check its name.
chat.error.insufficientBalance: The funding account has insufficient funds. Check the balance and amount.
chat.error.insufficientFunds: The funding balance of CNY {balance} cannot cover CNY {amount}. Adjust the amount.
chat.error.purchaseMinimum: The purchase amount is below the CNY {amount} minimum. Adjust the amount.
chat.error.limitExceeded: The amount exceeds the current limit. Check the limit and adjust the amount.
chat.error.securityDenied: The security check did not pass. Check the operation and its authorization status.
chat.error.verificationFailed: The verification code did not pass validation. Check the code.
chat.error.verificationRemaining: The verification code is incorrect. {count} attempts remain.
chat.error.verificationConsumed: This verification has already been used. Check the original operation card and its result.
chat.error.verificationExpired: This verification expired or the operation changed. Request a new verification from the original operation card.
chat.error.securityLocked: Security verification is locked. Check the status in the security center.
chat.error.stateChanged: The operation state changed. Refresh and check the original operation card.
chat.error.positiveTransfer: The transfer amount must be greater than CNY 0. Enter a new amount.
chat.error.positivePurchase: The purchase amount must be greater than CNY 0. Enter a new amount.
chat.error.limitCategoryRequired: The spending category is missing. Specify the category whose limit should change.
chat.error.nonNegativeLimit: The limit must be at least CNY 0. Enter a new amount.
chat.error.alreadyLost: The card is already reported lost. No repeat report is needed.
chat.error.resultUnavailable: The banking result could not be displayed. Refresh the records and check the outcome.
chat.display.smsHint: Enter the 6-digit demo verification code. No SMS is sent.
chat.display.demoHint: Enter the 6-digit demo verification code. No SMS is sent.
chat.display.safetyHint: This action requires verification. Enter the 6-digit demo verification code. No SMS is sent.
chat.value.fullRedemption: Redeem this entire holding; partial redemption is not supported.
chat.value.amountChange: Stop if the amount changes. Request a new approval.
chat.value.cardDemoScope: Save the card and monthly limit settings. The demo does not process card payments.
chat.value.taskDemoScope: Save the task record only. Execution when due is not guaranteed.
